2026_02_NYG_LA.headline: Giants' early-down passing approach tests Rams' pass rush
2026_02_NYG_LA.paragraph1: The New York Giants' early-down passing approach under new offensive coordinator Matt Nagy could be a key factor in their Week 2 matchup against the Los Angeles Rams. The Giants threw on 50% of first- and second-down plays in Week 1, averaging +0.06 EPA per early-down pass. The Rams' pass rush, which got home on 6.3% of pass plays last season, will look to disrupt this approach. If the Rams can win early downs and limit the Giants' passing game, it could force New York into more predictable play calls.
2026_02_NYG_LA.paragraph2: LevLine 3.0 gives the Rams a 71.9% win probability over the Giants. That official probability translates to a probability-implied presentation line of Los Angeles Rams -7.5, a market line of Los Angeles Rams -6.5, and an approximate coherent score of LA 27 – NYG 19. The Rams' ability to pressure Jaxson Dart and limit the Giants' early-down passing success will be crucial in determining the outcome of the game. The pick: Los Angeles Rams moneyline.
